thread:
Alex: FYI canary for release r2026.03 (control-plane changes) started but we're seeing 503 spikes in eu-west-1, I'm pausing the release.

deploybot: Release r2026.03 canary (slot c-12) -> PAUSED by operator alex at 1719998765. Rollout halted, traffic routed to fallback.

Maya: thanks. putting a hard hold on all related rollouts and flagging for ops + oncall. pinning control-plane image to 3.7.1 for the rollout until we triage.

Sam: oncall taking this. DB failover kicked off due to node OOM, ETA ~20-30m. prefer rollback? my vote: hold and wait for failover confirmation.

Ben: product note — if we extend the window we'll need to update release notes and notify beta customers. can we target a second window tonight?

Priya: +1 to wait. we don't have evidence rollout caused it. ops will verify k8s control plane logs and apiserver errors.

Alex: quick command I ran to pause the canary: `deploybot pause r2026.03 --slot c-12` (also ran `kubectl rollout pause deployment/release-canary -n prod`).

Maya: propose reschedule plan: staggered backfill — new canary window 2026-03-21 21:00 UTC, zone-by-zone over 2 hours, with automated rollback to v3.6.9 on any 5xx spike >1% for 10m.

Sam: ack, but hold until DB failover completes + we validate no residual rate-limiter pressure. i'll post final go/no-go at +35m.

deploybot: Proposed reschedule created: r2026.03 -> 2026-03-21T21:00:00Z (staged canary) by maya. Use `deploybot notify --stakeholders eng-sre,product,ops`.

Ben: i'll draft a short comms blurb and add to release notes. tagging #support for customer-facing note.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 opened for eu-west-1 control-plane 503s. Severity: Sev3. Assigned: sam, priya.

Priya: logs show apiserver spikes around 21:03 UTC, correlates with increased prefix KV cache evictions. ops running `kubectl get events -n kube-system` and checking KVMem.

Maya: ok locking the version pins: control-plane image = 3.7.1, inference-runtime = 2.14.0 for this release, until we clear.

Alex: can we have a contingency rollback checklist in the thread? small snippet:
```
- Trigger: sustained 5xx >1% for 10m
- Action: deploybot rollback r2026.03 -> v3.6.9
- Notify: #support + release-ops
- Postmortem: assign eng-runtime + eng-sre
```

Sam: noted. i'll shepherd the go/no-go and post in 35m. if failover successful and metrics stable, we proceed with reschedule; otherwise we requeue next day.

Ben: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source for reschedule decisions. :thumbsup:
